registry.item_title: Number of Participants Who Experienced Coronary Heart Disease (CHD) Death, Myocardial Infarction (MI), or Ischemic Stroke, Whichever Occurred First

item_title_witness.text: Number of Participants Who Experienced Coronary Heart Disease (CHD) Death, Myocardial Infarction (MI), or Ischemic Stroke, Whichever Occurred First

notes: Selected the first primary endpoint, 3-point MACE (CHD death, MI, or ischemic stroke), as the best match to the unspecified MACE outcome; the abstract explicitly identifies this composite as 3-point MACE. Both definitions are primary, so the row does not uniquely distinguish them. Alternative 4-point MACE adds ischemia-driven arterial revascularization: registry OG001 has 747/6129 and OG000 has 907/6128; the abstract agrees. Other registry composite candidates: Number of Participants Who Experienced MI, Ischemic Stroke, or Any Ischemia-driven Arterial Revascularization (OG001 674, OG000 834); Number of Participants Who Experienced CHD Death, MI, or Any Ischemia-driven Arterial Revascularization (OG001 664, OG000 819); Number of Participants Who Experienced Cardiovascular Death, MI, or Ischemic Stroke (OG001 374, OG000 503). All these outcome measures use denominators OG001 6129 and OG000 6128.
